## Provenance and limits

The user supplied https://twbsball.dils.tku.edu.tw/index.php?title=三商虎隊/三商虎隊的職棒十年 . Automated open returned Anubis Access Denied. No attempt was made to bypass it. The user then supplied a visible screenshot (`1794121053192.png`) showing the complete 1999 registration block: managers, coaches, pitchers, catchers, infielders, outfielders, and the explanation that numbers indicate joining/leaving months. This screenshot, not an alleged full-page fetch, is the transcription basis. It covers ONE season, not the entire ten-year roster or unseen annual pages. No screenshot image, surrounding prose, attendance anecdote, earthquake speculation, or disciplinary narrative is republished.

Annual page explicitly attributes grouping and months to this SECONDARY roster, separates registration from actual appearances, and does not describe all 35 players as independently confirmed game participants. Unmarked months mean no marker in source, not a full-season guarantee. Players without profiles remain plain names, not broken links or external player-list redirects.
